content.value_statement: Provisioning W&B through Azure Marketplace requires precise SDK models, authentication, and lifecycle handling. This skill provides focused .NET guidance for deployment, SSO, updates, listing, and deletion.
actual_capabilities: Installs the preview Azure management package and authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential.
Creates W&B Marketplace instances with offer, administrator, region, subdomain, and managed identity settings.
Retrieves and lists W&B instances at resource group and subscription scope.
Configures Entra ID SAML SSO and updates resource tags.
Deletes instances, handles common ARM errors, and checks whether a resource name exists.
Connects an Azure-deployed host to the W&B Python SDK for basic metric logging.
limitations: The documented package and API are previews, so types and behavior can change.
Examples require valid Azure permissions, Marketplace subscription details, administrator data, and environment-specific identifiers.
The skill provides guidance and examples; it does not execute deployments or validate live Azure state.
Name availability uses a lookup fallback because the SDK may not expose a dedicated operation.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap a .NET integration
use_cases.description: Install the SDK, authenticate safely, and create a first W&B Marketplace instance with placeholder configuration.

use_cases.title: Standardize MLOps provisioning
use_cases.description: Build repeatable workflows for listing, tagging, monitoring, and managing W&B instances across Azure scopes.

use_cases.title: Review enterprise access
use_cases.description: Configure Entra ID SAML SSO, managed identity, regions, and lifecycle controls for an organizational deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Install and authenticate
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to install the preview .NET package and authenticate with DefaultAzureCredential. Explain required Azure permissions and placeholders.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new .NET project

prompt_templates.title: Create an instance
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a W&B instance in [region] within [resource group]. Include Marketplace details, managed identity, provisioning checks, and safe placeholder values.

prompt_templates.title: Configure enterprise access
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Entra ID SAML SSO to [instance name] for [domains], then update governance tags. Preserve existing properties and explain validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design lifecycle operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production workflow for listing, updating, monitoring, and deleting W&B instances. Include error handling, approval gates, rollback considerations, and least privilege.

output_examples.input: Create a deployment checklist for a W&B instance in East US with managed identity and Entra ID SSO.
output_examples.output: Confirm subscription and Marketplace terms; gather administrator and SSO identifiers; create the instance; wait for Succeeded; validate identity, SSO, and tags.

output_examples.input: Explain how to update tags without replacing the W&B instance.
output_examples.output: Retrieve the existing resource, create a patch containing only the required tags, update the instance, and verify the returned resource details.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed production deletion workflow.
output_examples.output: Require explicit approval, verify subscription and resource identifiers, record dependencies, delete with completion waiting, and confirm the resource no longer exists.

best_practices: Use DefaultAzureCredential, managed identity, and least-privilege Azure roles.
Replace every placeholder and validate the Marketplace plan, region, subdomain, and SSO identifiers before deployment.
Wait for successful provisioning and handle RequestFailedException responses by status.
anti_patterns: Do not place real tenant identifiers, API keys, administrator emails, or subscription details in shared source.
Do not create, update, or delete production resources before confirming the subscription, resource group, instance name, and approval.
Do not assume preview types, supported regions, or Marketplace values remain stable without checking current documentation.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Azure operations?
faq.answer: No. It supplies guidance and examples; execution depends on your application, credentials, permissions, and selected Azure resources.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend?
faq.answer: It uses DefaultAzureCredential, which can select supported local, workload, or managed identity credentials.

faq.question: Is the Azure SDK package stable?
faq.answer: The documented package is version 1.0.0-beta.1 and uses a preview API. Verify current package documentation before implementation.

faq.question: Can it configure single sign-on?
faq.answer: Yes. It demonstrates Entra ID SAML SSO with an enterprise application identifier and approved domains.

faq.question: Does it manage machine learning experiments?
faq.answer: It manages the Azure W&B resource. A separate Python example shows basic W&B login, run initialization, metric logging, and completion.

faq.question: How should deletion be handled?
faq.answer: Verify the Azure scope and instance identity, obtain approval, review dependencies, wait for completion, and confirm removal.
